import datetime
import calendar

def next_billing_date(start: datetime.date, months_ahead: int) -> datetime.date:
    if months_ahead < 0:
        raise ValueError("months_ahead must be non-negative")
    year = start.year + (start.month - 1 + months_ahead) // 12
    month = (start.month - 1 + months_ahead) % 12 + 1
    day = start.day
    last_day = calendar.monthrange(year, month)[1]
    day = min(day, last_day)
    return datetime.date(year, month, day)
